method.startupMetric: Selection before fresh iframe creation to the first common moving-video-frame callback.
method.seekMetric: Seek action to the first moving target-video-frame callback, with genuine play-promise settlement required.

cacheModes.disabled: Fresh browser context per cohort and CDP cache disabled; excluded conditioning contexts discarded.
cacheModes.browser-managed: Shared context for this cache mode; one excluded four-engine conditioning cohort per origin. HTTP cache warmth is not asserted.

schedule.variantOrder: Alternating by pair and four-pair cycle; reversed in the second cache mode.

method.conditioning: Exactly one excluded four-engine conditioning cohort per variant origin and cache mode; retained separately below.
method.retention: All completed cohort outcomes and all 12 raw pairs are retained. No retries, replacement, trimming, or outlier exclusion.
method.summaryPopulation: Variant latency summaries use successful outcomes with observed timing. Paired summaries additionally require equal nonempty sampled resolutions; explicit n and exclusions are retained.
method.statistics: Median, linearly interpolated p90 at (n-1)*0.9, and unscaled median absolute deviation. Paired confidence intervals are not computed.
method.pairedOutcomeReferences: Every raw pair references its two cohort IDs. Engine startup/seek outcomes and marks are stored once in those cohorts.
method.scope: Fixture-specific local transport measurements; production network latency and broad player ranking are outside this dataset.

fixture.playlistHashScope: Comparison manifest bytes recorded by both frozen-build receipts; this digest does not cover media segments.
